API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APISecurity Policy SettingsUpdate Blacklist Ur Ls
Update Blacklist Ur Ls
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/security/advanced/blacklistUrls

Adds a URL to or removes a URL from the denylist. To add a URL to the denylist, set the action parameter to ADD_TO_LIST. To remove a URL, set action to REMOVE_FROM_LIST.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
action
string
REQUIRED

Possible values: [ADD_TO_LIST, REMOVE_FROM_LIST]

The action applied to the Advanced Threat Protection policy’s denylist (i.e., adding a URL or removing a URL).

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
blacklistUrls
string[]

URLs on the denylist for your organization. Allow up to 25000 URLs.
